quests.title: The Bodleian Declaration
quests.summary: Swear the Bodleian oath, never to kindle fire or flame, then find the bestiary leaf a don has borrowed.

steps.text: Make the Declaration to the Librarian at the Bodleian, and ask about the missing leaf.
Ask the clerk in the Radcliffe Camera which way the reader went.
Find the don in the back of the Eagle and Child, and win the leaf back.
Return the leaf to the Librarian at the Bodleian.

quests.reward: The Reader's Ticket (a Lore charm), two Banbury Cakes and standing in England.
